digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation validity and drift refresh
propositions: Signed material pins must serve as the single validity check for related-material across attestation lifecycle consumers with safe rollout for existing projects
When enforce_plan_material_pins is enabled, stale pin drift, missing pinned targets, or malformed pin records invalidate attestations; when disabled they remain advisory

Derived health aggregates target pin status by severity (malformed-pin > stale-pin-missing > stale-pin-drift > current) and must be computed before cheaper existing early returns so audit can diagnose simultaneous drift
Re-sign recovery must validate reviewed-related-material pins from the sidecar without calling compute_validity and must refuse re-sign when enforcement is enabled and pins are invalid
Full LLM plan review must thread the exact pre-LLM related_material snapshot through sidecar emission and must preserve plan_review_result_v2 schema so pre-feature sidecars ignore the additive field

drift_refresh_candidate must delegate all validity checks including signature, kind, registry, own-material, and pins to compute_validity(profile=DRIFT_REFRESH) and retain only code-drift qualification inline
